title: yellow-yolked greek chicken tart
description: spicy, molten, energizing Greek dish featuring shortcrust pastry, sashimi-cut chicken, and binchotan-grill cooking method. Inspired by Mediterranean flavors, this recipe is Whole30-friendly and perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Roll out shortcrust pastry and place on a baking sheet.
Cut the chicken breast into sashimi-cut pieces and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together red onion, red bell pepper, feta cheese, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, jalapeño, salt, and black pepper.
Arrange the chicken pieces on one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Spoon the onion mixture over the chicken.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with egg wash and make a few small slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the tart on the preheated binchotan grill and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
